common.tagline: জাতিসংঘের টেকসই উন্নয়ন লক্ষ্য (SDGs) ভিত্তিক প্রভাব পরিমাপ ও প্রতিবেদন SaaS

home.apiOffline: ক্যাটালগ API-এর সাথে সংযোগ স্থাপন করা যাচ্ছে না। {dev} অথবা {compose} দিয়ে আপনার লোকাল পরিবেশ চালু করুন।

auth.signUpHint: একটি নতুন ওয়ার্কস্পেস (টেন্যান্ট) এবং অ্যাডমিনিস্ট্রেটর অ্যাকাউন্ট তৈরি করুন।

goal.noTargets: এই লক্ষ্যের জন্য এখনও কোনো নমুনা টার্গেট নেই।

glossary.title: Plain-language glossary (translation needed)
glossary.intro: This glossary is not yet translated to বাংলা. Contributions welcome at docs/principles/bn.md.

yourCallingCard.explain: A short page where you tell others what SDG you care about, what you can offer, and what you need.

spark.explain: A small action — like a save or a thumbs up — that tells us you might want to learn more about someone.

companion.explain: Someone you and they have both agreed to connect with.

kindred.explain: We compare what you wrote about yourself with what others wrote, to suggest people who think and care about similar things.

mustHave.explain: Rules that decide who you definitely won't be matched with — for example, you must share at least one common language.

fairnessBoost.explain: We give a small extra visibility to people whose voices are usually missed — for example, those working in least-developed countries — so the network does not just amplify the already-loud.

yourSpace.explain: Your data is stored separately from every other organisation. No one in another organisation can ever see it.

privacyLine.explain: A rule built into our database so that even our own code cannot accidentally show someone else's data.

changeRecord.explain: Whenever something important changes, we write down who changed it and when, so you can always check the history.

privacyMask.explain: Before AI reads your text, we hide personal details like names, phone numbers, and addresses.

watch.title: This week's findings
watch.intro: Each week, we look at what UN agencies, donors, researchers, and grassroots groups are saying about the SDG you care about.
watch.noFindings: No findings this week match your filter. Try widening it.
watch.subscribe: Get this in my language each week
watch.expressInterest: I want to learn more / collaborate
watch.interestRecorded: Saved to your private list. We will not contact anyone for you — you decide if and when.
watch.publicFeed: Public weekly feed (re-syndicate freely under CC BY 4.0)
watch._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

column.todayIntro: A short, sourced piece selected against our public Content Standard.
column.byStandard: Curated under Content Standard {version} — every published piece records this version.
column.approveDescription: We never auto-publish. A column reaches readers only after at least one human approver clicks approve. Sensitive topics need two.

approveDecision.reject: Reject (this finding will not be published)

column.approveExpired: This approval link has expired. Please ask the editor to re-issue.
column.approveAlreadyDecided: This approval link has already been used. Each link is single-use.
column.approveTokenInvalid: We could not verify this approval link. The signature does not match.
column.approveSuccess: Thank you. Your decision was recorded at {time}.
column.managingApproversBody: Adding or removing an approver is itself a sensitive action. Two administrators must agree, and the change is recorded in the immutable audit log.
column.partnerBody: Partner organisations may receive every published column via signed webhook (HMAC-SHA256) or by polling the public Atom feed under CC BY 4.0. Partners never see drafts, subscriptions, or private interests.
column._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

dashboard.sectionPostSdgsBody: Themes the global community is starting to discuss for the era after the SDGs.
dashboard.sourceTabExternalBody: Curated research, papers, articles, columns, newsletters, and verified social posts from outside our platform — only those that pass the 12-rule integrity check.
dashboard.sourceTabInternalBody: Newsletters, columns, and papers we publish ourselves.
dashboard.researchIntro: Plan a new study or initiative inspired by what you've found. Visible only inside your workspace until you share.
dashboard.outreachIntro: Draft a message to a researcher, practitioner, or partner. We never send on your behalf — you click send.
dashboard.monitoringIntro: Holistic view of integrity, approvals, partners, research, and the watch pipeline. Reading this view is itself recorded in the audit log.
dashboard.chatIntro: Type in your language. The other side reads in theirs. The original is always preserved.
dashboard._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

story.todayShortIntro: A short, sourced piece adapted to your language and age group. Always shows the source. AI-assisted; humans approve every variant.
story.neverAutoPost: We never auto-post. A human approves each variant before it can be sent to any platform.
story.watermarkExplain: Every video carries a corner watermark indicating it is AI-assisted and showing its source.
story._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

strategy.toneIntro: Five tones — playful, friend, solemn, instructive, reflective. Pick the one that matches the moment, never preach.
strategy.ethicsClosing: Implicit reminder: what we make today shapes the AI of tomorrow, which shapes the humans after.
strategy.trendBenchBody: We track average length, hook timing and hashtag frequency per platform × locale. We never copy or republish anyone's content.
strategy.patentBody: A newly published patent or copyright filing, mapped to which SDG and which region it can serve. Never republished commercially.
strategy.sessionIntro: Talk through how a new technology can serve an SDG, with people you have invited. Non-commercial use only.
strategy.noncommercialClause: I agree to use this session's content only for non-commercial SDG implementation.
strategy.revokeNotice: A super-administrator may revoke this session at any time if it stops serving the SDGs. The reason is recorded forever.
strategy.sessionRevokedBanner: This session was revoked on {when}. Reason: {reason}
strategy._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

research.title: Research authoring sessions
research.intro: Insights gathered from many sources are woven into multidisciplinary manuscripts — at Nature tier or SSCI tier — written collaboratively here. Every published paper carries a five-paragraph plain-language summary anyone can read.
research.natureTier: Nature tier — natural-science / impact primary research
research.ssciTier: SSCI tier — social-science, policy, practice research
research.plainSummaryRequired: Before publishing, a plain-language summary in English AND in the primary locale is required.
research.ldcCoauthorPrompt: At least one co-author from an LDC-affiliated institution broadens the view.
research.selfCiteWarning: Self-citation exceeds 20%. Please record an editor's reason.
research.publishedNote: Citations freeze at publication. Corrections happen only via separate erratum.
research._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

book.title: Book authoring — accessible to anyone
book.intro: Books are re-arrangements of already-approved columns, card news, and papers. The work is curation and plain-language refinement — not writing from scratch.
book.plainScoreGate: Plain-language score must be at least 60 to publish.
book.ldcLanguageHint: Books targeting LDCs must include at least one chapter language local to that region.
book._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

impact.title: Impact verification — without invading privacy
impact.intro: A subscription or a like is not consent. To include your engagement in any impact study you must opt in separately. You can revoke any time.
impact.consentClause: I agree that my SDG-related signals may be included, anonymously and aggregate-only, in SDG impact studies.
impact.revokedNote: Already-published studies remain, but you are excluded from the next aggregation cycle onward.
impact.kFloorNote: No result is ever released externally unless at least {floor} people share the same cohort.
impact.publishGate: Publication needs two human reviewers (one of whom is an SDG domain expert) to approve.
impact._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

funding.title: Funding — donations + impact investment
funding.intro: Region-by-region SDG practitioners publish proposals; donors, sponsors, and impact investors connect. This platform never holds funds itself — payment partners handle the money flow.
funding.noncommercialClause: I agree that funds for this proposal will be used only for non-commercial SDG implementation.
funding.modelAllOrNothing: All-or-nothing — full refund if the goal is missed
funding.modelKeepItAll: Keep-it-all — use what is collected (allowed only for emergency relief)
funding.milestoneEvidenceHint: Each milestone release requires evidence (video / photo / external URL) and approval by two reviewers.
funding.singleContribCap: A single backer cannot contribute more than 25% of the goal — no whale-driven decisions.
funding.pauseNotice: A super-administrator may pause a suspect proposal at any time. The reason is recorded forever.
funding.reportIntro: Backers can see the verified outcome of their funds via a linked impact study.
funding._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

maker.title: Maker space for SDG practitioners
maker.intro: You don't need to write code from scratch. Start from a template that already includes i18n, RLS, plain language, and ethics tones — then build the web, app, or bot you need.
maker.noncommercialClause: I will use this tool only for non-commercial SDG implementation.
maker.readmeGate: Before going live, at least one artifact must score ≥ 60 on the plain-language README check.
maker.licenseHint: Default licences: MIT, Apache-2.0, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 — choose one.
maker.ldcLanguageHint: Tools targeting LDCs are encouraged to include at least one local language.
maker.aiProvenance: AI-assisted code lines automatically record their model and prompt version.
maker._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

needs.title: Needs and sharing exchange
needs.intro: When a region says what it needs, the world can see it and people who can give are matched. The platform never auto-sends messages — a match is only a suggestion.
needs.contactMaskNotice: Until BOTH sides accept, neither side sees the other's contact details — server responses mask them.
needs.fulfilmentSignClause: I confirm receipt and agree to the platform's terms.
needs.ldcBoostNotice: Critical-urgency requests from LDC regions surface automatically at the top of search and feeds.
needs._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

bizplan.title: AI-assisted plan authoring — business, policy, ODA
bizplan.intro: Drawing on the platform's real-time data (patents, weekly findings, columns, manuscripts), we co-author SDG-aligned plans. AI never asserts without a citation.
bizplan.noncommercialClause: I agree to use this plan only for non-commercial SDG implementation.
bizplan.trackImmutable: Track cannot be changed once set. A different track requires a new plan.
bizplan.citationRequired: Every AI-drafted section (except executive summary) must cite a platform first source.
bizplan.pledgeWordCap: Pledge sections must be ≤ 200 words and written in plain language.
bizplan.twoReviewerNotice: ODA and policy tracks need two human reviewers (one a domain expert) before ready_for_use.
bizplan._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

feasibility.title: Multidisciplinary feasibility review (6 axes)
feasibility.intro: Impact, financial, technical, legal, ethical, evidence — each 0–100. If any axis falls below 40 the plan cannot move to ready_for_use.
feasibility.axisEthical: Ethical — harm guard and non-targeted harm
feasibility.axisEvidence: Evidence — diversity and strength of citations
feasibility.humanAdjustNotice: Domain experts may adjust each axis; the reason is recorded forever.
feasibility._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

expert.title: Expert competency matching
expert.intro: We suggest experts based on domain, language, field experience, LDC weight, and availability. The platform never auto-sends messages.
expert.verifiedBadge: Verified credential — granted only by external authority or admin
expert.selfReportNotice: Users cannot grant themselves the 'verified' tier.
expert.contactMaskNotice: Until BOTH sides accept, contact details are excluded from the response.
expert.ldcBoostNotice: Experts with LDC field experience are surfaced for plans whose impact reaches LDC regions.
expert._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.

extensibility.title: Extensibility — future features without touching the core
extensibility.intro: When tomorrow's SDG practitioners need a feature we never imagined, they can add it without forking the core. New domains, workflows, and event subscriptions slot in safely.
extensibility.pluginManifestIntro: Declares a plugin's identity, version, and requested capabilities. Non-commercial and plain-language pledges are mandatory.
extensibility.noncommercialPledge: All content this plugin produces will be used only for non-commercial SDG implementation.
extensibility.plainLanguagePledge: User-facing surfaces of this plugin follow the plain-language standard.
extensibility.governanceTierStrict: Strict governance — ODA / policy plugins require an extra super-admin approval.
extensibility.customDomainIntro: Declare a new data type via JSON Schema; every record write is validated automatically. Fields listed in piiFields are masked before any AI call.
extensibility.workflowIntro: Declare a state machine without writing code. Trigger 'emit' values must be event names — arbitrary execution is not supported.
extensibility.eventLogNotice: Domain events are append-only — once recorded they cannot be edited or deleted. Mistakes are corrected by emitting a corrective event.
extensibility.capabilityTokenNotice: Capability tokens are returned in raw form ONLY ONCE on issue. Lost tokens cannot be retrieved — issue a new one.
extensibility.tokenScopeNotice: A token's grantedScopes must be a subset of the manifest's requestedScopes.
extensibility.webhookSecretNotice: Webhook secrets are also revealed only once at creation. The platform stores only their SHA-256 hash.
extensibility.autoDeactivateNotice: After five consecutive webhook failures the subscription auto-deactivates. A super-admin must explicitly reactivate.
extensibility.featureFlagNotice: Feature flags let a super-admin disable any plugin instantly — the platform's final kill switch.
extensibility._translationNeeded: Not yet translated to বাংলা. PR welcome.
